name: cs_pug_webext
description: Extension de navigateur créée avec PureScript et Pug

scripts.build: npm run build:purescript && npm run build:bundle
scripts.dev:chrome: cross-env APP_MODE=dev TARGET_BROWSER=chrome npm run watch
scripts.dev:firefox: cross-env APP_MODE=dev TARGET_BROWSER=firefox npm run watch
scripts.prod:chrome: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome APP_MODE=prod node config/esbuild.config.js && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome node config/zip.js
scripts.prod:firefox: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox APP_MODE=prod node config/esbuild.config.js && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox node config/zip.js
scripts.prod: npm run prod:chrome && npm run prod:firefox
